assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a professional GitHub repository cover, wide 3:1 landscape. Image 1 is approved Cheditte style reference ONLY (Jira). Reimagine IMAP cover in the exact illustrated language of Image 1: dark plum #231A28 ground, cream #F4F0E8 bold sans serif title, lime #D4E86A meaningful connections, muted lavender #BDB4C2, crisp outlined isometric objects with flat cream front and plum side faces. No glossy 3D. Left 53%: title on two lines 'abap-imap' then 'inbound' in large bold cream. Under title 'Mail & attachments in SAP'. Use case: infographic-diagram. Make a premium illustrated setup roadmap for abap-imap-inbound. 16:9 landscape. Image 1 is approved dark plum illustrated style. Image 2 is old IMAP roadmap to replace; retain its informational hierarchy but not its style. Images 3 and 4 are supplied SAP and curl logos. Palette dark plum #231A28, cream #F4F0E8, lime #D4E86A, muted lavender #BDB4C2. Bold sans-serif, flat crisp outlined isometric illustrations. No glossy objects, no giant empty boxes. Header small lime 'abap-imap-inbound', large cream 'Three parts to prepare'. Under it three evenly spaced illustrated columns, divided by subtle vertical lines, no arrows between columns because these are preparation areas, not three new servers. Column 1 '1  Mailbox', illustration isometric envelope beside source and destination folders. Caption two lines 'IMAP access' / 'Source & destination folders'. Column 2 '2  SAP host', cream/plum isometric server plus small protected folder with padlock. Word 'PowerShell' plain text and supplied curl logo with cream wordmark/lime slash, directly on dark background without badge. Caption 'Scripts & protected storage'. Column 3 '3  SAP programs', isometric monitor displaying three mail rows and one attachment, supplied blue SAP logo small, no background badge. Caption 'One installer' / 'Profile & authorizations'. Lower strip heading 'First use', three clearly separated short steps with lime arrows: 'List only' → 'Process one mail' → 'Open in monitor'. Small footer 'Use your existing mailbox and SAP host'. Generous readable spacing. Logos must be supplied shapes; omit curl source background, preserve its shape. Content complete, no more text.
